patches.name: In-app patch settings
patches.description: Adds a 'MaterialTidal' menu inside TIDAL's main Settings screen so you can toggle and customize installed MaterialTidal patches live without re-patching, with quick controls, organized sub-pages, and per-page or full reset.

patches.name: Linn Majik DSM Wi-Fi playback
patches.description: Discovers Linn DS/DSM OpenHome speakers on your local Wi-Fi in TIDAL's Devices sheet and streams Lossless or Hi-Res FLAC audio with full transport, queue, hardware volume, and lockscreen controls.

options.title: Preferred audio quality
options.description: Audio quality streamed to Linn Majik DSM over Wi-Fi; Hi-Res remuxes 24-bit/192 kHz lossless audio cleanly (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Stream delivery mode
options.description: Local HTTP Proxy supports all Linn DSM/1–5 generations including bit-perfect 24-bit/192 kHz FLAC (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Auto-wake standby & switch input
options.description: Automatically wakes the Linn Majik DSM from standby and switches its source to Playlist when selected in TIDAL (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Manual Linn DSM IP (optional fallback)
options.description: Optional LAN IP address (e.g. 192.168.1.50 or 192.168.1.50:55178) if automatic Wi-Fi discovery is blocked (also editable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 albums, artists & library
patches.description: Extends M3 design (fading hero artwork, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and a Bento-style Collection tile grid) to Albums, Artists, My Tracks, and your Library.

options.title: Expressive Album pages
options.description: Apply fading hero artwork, adaptive Monet colors, pill controls, and connected action bars to Album pages and My Albums (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Expressive Artist pages
options.description: Apply fading portrait heroes, adaptive Monet colors, contributor chips, pill controls, and connected action bars to Artist pages and My Artists (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Expressive My Tracks screen
options.description: Apply Monet pill Play/Shuffle controls, a tonal Offline Download card, and polished track rows to My Tracks (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Expressive Collection tile grid
options.description: Redesigns the Library collection menu into a Bento-style tile grid with circular tonal top-bar buttons (also toggleable in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 bottom sheets & menus
patches.description: Redesigns Song & Playlist action menus as clean tap-anchored M3 popups with crisp vector icons, alongside rounded bottom sheets, grouped menu cards, overflow menus, and M3 dialogs.

options.title: Sheet & menu corner style
options.description: Controls corner roundness for bottom sheets, popup menus, and dialogs across TIDAL (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Grouped context menu cards
options.description: Style track, album, playlist, and settings bottom-sheet rows as grouped tonal cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Expressive overflow & dropdown menus
options.description: Apply rounded Monet containers, clean spacing, and pill ripples to overflow and dropdown menus (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: M3 dialogs
options.description: Upgrade pop-up confirmation and selection dialogs with rounded Monet surfaces and pill action buttons (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 full player
patches.description: Redesigns the Now Playing screen with a blurred cover-art backdrop, adaptive Monet colors, animated squiggly seekbar, expressive transport controls, responsive tablet two-pane layout, full-screen lyrics, and a refreshed Play Queue.

options.title: Player backdrop style
options.description: Controls how the blurred album-art background and tonal accents are rendered (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Swipe cover art to skip tracks
options.description: Swipe the album cover horizontally with spring tilt physics to skip to the next or previous track (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Squiggly sine-wave seekbar
options.description: Animates the active progress line as a Material 3 wave while playing; automatically replaced when 'Song waveform seekbar' is active (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Expressive Play Queue
options.description: Redesigns the Play Queue and Suggested Tracks view with cover-adaptive backdrops, pill tabs, a spotlight active track card, and rounded rows (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Desktop-style tablet layout
options.description: Uses a two-pane layout with side-by-side Play Queue & Lyrics, a three-zone bottom playback dock, and volume slider on tablets and wide screens (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 homepage
patches.description: Redesigns the Homepage with rounded M3 shortcut and carousel cards, Monet-styled Vibe chips and top bar, pull-to-refresh support, and optional removal of promotional banners.

options.title: Cover & shortcut corner shape
options.description: Corner radius style for album/playlist carousel artwork and quick-access shortcut cards (can also be changed in Settings → MaterialTidal; restart recommended).

options.title: Homepage pull-to-refresh
options.description: Enables pull-to-refresh at the top of the Homepage feed (also toggleable in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Hide Headliners upload banner
options.description: Hides the top creator upload promotional banner on the Homepage (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Hide promo modules
options.description: Hides promotional banners shown between Homepage music carousels (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Hide merch store modules
options.description: Hides merchandise shopping carousels from the Homepage (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 navbar & mini-player
patches.description: Replaces TIDAL's bottom bar and mini-player with a floating M3 split-pill navigation dock, detached Search button, and separate floating mini-player card with swipe gestures and progressive backdrop blur.

options.title: Navbar & mini-player style
options.description: Color palette style for the floating navigation dock and mini-player (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Keep 3 core tabs in dock
options.description: Shows Home, Explore, and Library in the left pill and Search in the detached circle button, hiding the Uploads tab (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Mini-player swipe gestures
options.description: Swipe the floating mini-player left or right to skip tracks and pull up to expand the full-screen player (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Progressive dock blur
options.description: Replaces the solid bottom fade behind the floating navigation dock and mini-player with a frosted progressive blur (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 playlist screen
patches.description: Redesigns Playlist pages with a full-bleed fading hero cover, cover-adaptive or Monet colors, pill Play/Shuffle controls, compact expressive action buttons (or full hide), scroll-morphing toolbar, and polished track rows.

options.title: Playlist accent palette
options.description: Extract accent colors dynamically from each playlist cover or always follow your system Monet wallpaper (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Full-bleed fading hero cover
options.description: Display playlist artwork edge-to-edge at the top with a smooth downward fade into the background (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Expressive track rows
options.description: Round track artwork corners and add pill touch ripples while keeping TIDAL's active-track indicator (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Hide playlist action buttons
options.description: Hide the secondary playlist action bar (Favorite, Edit, Download, Privacy, Share; also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: M3 search
patches.description: Redesigns Search & Explore with rounded Monet search bars, frosted sticky headers, expressive filter pills, and Monet-harmonized genre and browse cards.

options.title: Search bar shape
options.description: Corner style used for the Search input bar across Explore and active search screens (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Expressive Genre & Explore cards
options.description: Style Browse/Explore genre tiles, pill tags, and navigation rows as tonal Material 3 cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Frosted glass Search header
options.description: Float scrolling Explore and Search results smoothly beneath a frosted blurred header bar (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Material You dynamic theme
patches.description: Applies your Android wallpaper's Material You Monet colors, rounder M3 shapes, and smooth frosted-glass blur across TIDAL's surfaces, accents, and cards. Options can also be adjusted live in Settings → MaterialTidal.

options.title: AMOLED pure black background
options.description: Uses a pure #000000 Dark Mode background instead of a tinted dark surface while keeping Monet accents and elevated cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Monet palette intensity
options.description: Controls how strongly your wallpaper's Monet colors tint app surfaces and cards (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: M3 rounded shapes
options.description: Upgrades button, card, and container corners across TIDAL to rounder M3 squircle and pill shapes (can also be toggled in Settings → MaterialTidal; restart recommended).

options.title: Expressive frosted-glass blur
options.description: Enables smooth hardware-accelerated blur on hero artwork fades, sticky toolbars, floating bars, menus, and sheets (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Blur intensity
options.description: Controls the strength of progressive blur fades and frosted glass surfaces (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Seamless track transitions (Crossfade)
patches.description: Unlocks dual-player Crossfade with adjustable duration (0–12 s), 4 audio fade curves, blend intensity, gapless-album preservation, and a clean full-screen Crossfade menu in Settings and the Now Playing menu.

options.title: Default crossfade duration
options.description: Initial crossfade overlap length in seconds (adjustable live anytime in Settings → MaterialTidal, Audio & Playback, or the Now Playing menu).

options.title: Default transition curve
options.description: Audio volume curve used when blending outgoing and incoming tracks (adjustable live in the Crossfade menu).

options.title: Default blend intensity
options.description: Controls how strongly both tracks overlap at the midpoint of a transition (adjustable from 0% to 100% in the Crossfade menu).

options.title: Keep albums gapless by default
options.description: Plays consecutive tracks from the same album gaplessly without crossfading (can be toggled live in the Crossfade menu).

patches.name: Song waveform seekbar
patches.description: Replaces the player seekbar with an animated audio waveform generated from the playing track, featuring smooth track transitions, scrub zoom, and optional real-time beat pulse.

options.title: Waveform shape
options.description: Visual style used to draw the song's audio waveform along the seekbar (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Waveform detail
options.description: Number of bars or curve segments drawn across the waveform seekbar (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Live beat pulse at playhead
options.description: Makes the waveform subtly pulse with real-time audio loudness around the playhead (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Syllable-synced karaoke lyrics
patches.description: Upgrades full-screen lyrics with word-by-word karaoke sweep highlighting, gentle lift physics, depth-of-field blur on inactive lines, duet layout, and open community lyric providers with automatic fallback to TIDAL lyrics.

options.title: Progressive blur on inactive lines
options.description: Applies smooth depth-of-field blur to inactive lyric lines, clearing as each line enters focus or while scrolling (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Lyrics blur intensity
options.description: Controls how strongly inactive lyric lines blur based on distance from the active line (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: System Light & Dark theme
patches.description: Adds a Material You Light Mode and automatically switches TIDAL between Light and Dark themes following your Android system setting (or locks to Light or Dark), adapting surfaces, icons, text contrast, dialogs, and system bars.

options.title: App theme mode
options.description: Switch TIDAL automatically between Light and Dark theme using Android's system setting, or lock it to Light or Dark (also switchable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

patches.name: Track swipe gestures
patches.description: Adds spring-back left and right swipe actions to track rows across playlists, albums, search, and your library (Add to Queue, Play Next, Favorite, or Add to Playlist).

options.title: Swipe right action
options.description: Action triggered when swiping a track row to the right (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Swipe left action
options.description: Action triggered when swiping a track row to the left (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Haptic feedback
options.description: Vibrate subtly when crossing the swipe threshold and triggering an action (also adjustable live in Settings → MaterialTidal).

options.title: Swipe threshold (dp)
options.description: Horizontal drag distance in dp required to trigger a swipe action (36–160; also adjustable live via slider in Settings → MaterialTidal).
